View3DCursor.location.title: 3D Cursor Location
View3DCursor.location.body: Where the 3D cursor sits: the red and white ring. New objects appear here, and it can act as a pivot for rotating and scaling.
View3DCursor.location.shortcut: Shift+Right-click to place it, Shift+C to reset it to the center
View3DCursor.location.try: Shift+Right-click the floor, then Shift+A, Mesh, Cube.

MESH_OT_primitive_cube_add.title: Add Cube
MESH_OT_primitive_cube_add.body: Adds a 2 meter cube at the 3D cursor. The most famous default object in 3D.

MESH_OT_primitive_uv_sphere_add.title: Add UV Sphere
MESH_OT_primitive_uv_sphere_add.body: A ball made of rings and segments, like lines of latitude and longitude on a globe. Great for planets, eyeballs, and heads.
MESH_OT_primitive_uv_sphere_add.try: Add one, then open the panel in the bottom-left corner and raise Segments.

MESH_OT_primitive_uv_sphere_add.segments.title: Segments
MESH_OT_primitive_uv_sphere_add.segments.body: How many slices run around the sphere, like orange wedges. More segments means a smoother outline and a heavier mesh.

MESH_OT_primitive_uv_sphere_add.ring_cou.title: Rings
MESH_OT_primitive_uv_sphere_add.ring_cou.body: How many bands stack from pole to pole. Raise it together with Segments for an evenly smooth ball.

MESH_OT_primitive_uv_sphere_add.radius.title: Radius
MESH_OT_primitive_uv_sphere_add.radius.body: Distance from the center to the surface, in meters. A radius of 1 makes a ball 2 meters across.

MESH_OT_primitive_ico_sphere_add.title: Add Ico Sphere
MESH_OT_primitive_ico_sphere_add.body: A ball built from triangles, like a geodesic dome. Even everywhere, with no pinched poles. Lovely for rocks and sculpting.

MESH_OT_primitive_cylinder_add.title: Add Cylinder
MESH_OT_primitive_cylinder_add.body: A tube with caps. Pillars, cans, wheels, pencils.

MESH_OT_primitive_cone_add.title: Add Cone
MESH_OT_primitive_cone_add.body: A cylinder whose top shrinks to a point. Party hats, roofs, carrots.

MESH_OT_primitive_plane_add.title: Add Plane
MESH_OT_primitive_plane_add.body: One flat square face. Floors, walls, pieces of paper, and the start of countless models.

MESH_OT_primitive_torus_add.title: Add Torus
MESH_OT_primitive_torus_add.body: A donut. The official mascot of every Blender beginner tutorial ever made.

MESH_OT_primitive_monkey_add.title: Add Monkey
MESH_OT_primitive_monkey_add.body: Suzanne, Blender's monkey mascot. Her lumpy face is perfect for testing lights, materials, and modifiers.

OBJECT_OT_light_add.title: Add Light
OBJECT_OT_light_add.body: Adds a lamp. Point glows in all directions, Sun lights the whole world from one angle, Spot makes a cone, Area is a soft glowing panel.

OBJECT_OT_camera_add.title: Add Camera
OBJECT_OT_camera_add.body: Adds a camera. Renders are taken through the active camera.

OBJECT_OT_text_add.title: Add Text
OBJECT_OT_text_add.body: Adds 3D text. Press Tab to type new words into it, then Tab again to finish.

OBJECT_OT_empty_add.title: Add Empty
OBJECT_OT_empty_add.body: An invisible helper: a point with a position, rotation, and scale but no shape. Used as a handle, a target, or a parent for other objects.

SpaceView3D.show_region_toolbar.title: Toolbar
SpaceView3D.show_region_toolbar.body: Shows or hides the tall strip of tools on the left of the viewport.

SpaceView3D.show_region_ui.title: Sidebar
SpaceView3D.show_region_ui.body: Shows or hides the sidebar on the right: exact numbers for the selected object, tool settings, and view options, sorted into tabs.

SpaceView3D.show_region_hud.title: Adjust Last Operation
SpaceView3D.show_region_hud.body: The panel in the bottom-left corner that appears right after you do something. Change its settings and Blender redoes the action with your new values.
SpaceView3D.show_region_hud.shortcut: F9 opens it as a popup

View3DShading.light.title: Lighting
View3DShading.light.body: How Solid mode lights your scene. Studio is a soft fake studio light, Flat has no shading at all, and MatCap paints every surface with a material ball image.

View3DShading.color_type.title: Color
View3DShading.color_type.body: Which color Solid mode paints objects with: one shared color, each object's material color, a random color per object (great for telling things apart), or textures.

View3DOverlay.show_floor.title: Floor Grid
View3DOverlay.show_floor.body: The grid floor you see in perspective views. Purely a guide: it never renders.
